FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_BloomCasting_DynamicMSR
(*
 * ==================================================================================================
 * SYSTEM IDENTIFIER  : FB_BloomCasting_DynamicMSR
 * CLASSIFICATION     : Continuous Casting Level 1 / Level 2 Cyber-Physical Metallurgy Automation
 * TARGET DOMAIN      : Continuous Steel Bloom Casting: Dynamic Mechanical Soft Reduction (MSR)
 *                      Roll Gap Positioning, Crater End Tracking & Centerline Segregation Prevention
 * GOVERNING STANDARDS: IEC 61131-3 3rd Ed., IEC 61508 SIL-2/3 Functional Safety, ISA-18.2 Alarm Mgmt
 * METALLURGICAL MODEL: Solute Microsegregation (Scheil-Gulliver C, Mn, P, S Partitioning),
 *                      Darcy Squeeze Flow in Dendritic Mushy Matrix, Dynamic Crater End Point Tracking
 * CONTROL TOPOLOGY   : Discrete State-Space Observer (4-State Luenberger/Kalman Architecture) +
 *                      Model Predictive Roll Gap Taper Control (MPC) with 2oo3 TMR Sensor Redundancy,
 *                      Anti-Internal-Crack Strain Limiting, and Hydraulic Soft Relief Safeguard
 * ==================================================================================================
 *)

VAR_INPUT
    (* --- 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY: STRAND WITHDRAWAL SPEED SENSORS --- *)
    rVc_CastingSpeed_A          : REAL;     (* Laser Surface Velocimeter Strand Speed Ch-A [m/min] *)
    rVc_CastingSpeed_B          : REAL;     (* Pinch Roll Calibrated Optical Encoder Ch-B [m/min] *)
    rVc_CastingSpeed_C          : REAL;     (* Straightener Drive Resolver Feedback Ch-C [m/min] *)

    (* --- 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY: TUNDISH CONTINUOUS TEMPERATURE SENSORS --- *)
    rTT_TundishTemp_A           : REAL;     (* Tundish Refractory-Shielded Type-B Thermocouple Ch-A [deg C] *)
    rTT_TundishTemp_B           : REAL;     (* Tundish Refractory-Shielded Type-B Thermocouple Ch-B [deg C] *)
    rTT_TundishTemp_C           : REAL;     (* Tundish Optical Pyrometer Fiber-Optic Probe Ch-C [deg C] *)

    (* --- 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY: HYDRAULIC REDUCTION CYLINDER PRESSURE --- *)
    rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A     : REAL;     (* Hydraulic Soft Reduction Cap-End Pressure Transducer Ch-A [bar] *)
    rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B     : REAL;     (* Hydraulic Soft Reduction Cap-End Pressure Transducer Ch-B [bar] *)
    rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C     : REAL;     (* Hydraulic Soft Reduction Cap-End Pressure Transducer Ch-C [bar] *)

    (* --- SEGMENT POSITION & MECHANICAL LOAD FEEDBACK --- *)
    rLVDT_RollGap_Actual        : REAL;     (* Linear Variable Differential Transformer Gap Sensor [mm] *)
    rLoadCell_SeparatingForce   : REAL;     (* Segment Frame Calibrated Load Cell Total Reaction Force [ton] *)

    (* --- PROCESS COOLING WATER & OPTICAL PYROMETRY MEASUREMENTS --- *)
    rFT_SecondaryCoolWater      : REAL;     (* Secondary Cooling Zone 5/6 Water Spray Mass Delivery [l/min] *)
    rT_BloomSurfaceTemp         : REAL;     (* Multi-Wavelength Infrared Pyrometer Strand Surface Temp [deg C] *)
    rWeight_Tundish             : REAL;     (* Continuous Tundish Steel Mass Load Cell Weighing [ton] *)

    (* --- SUPERVISORY OPERATIONAL PERMISSIVES & GEOMETRIC STEEL RECIPE --- *)
    bSysEnable                  : BOOL;     (* Master Casting Automation Level 2 Soft Reduction Enable *)
    bEmergencyStop              : BOOL;     (* Hardwired SIL-3 Safety Relay Health Interlock (Active-High OK) *)
    rCycleTimeSec               : REAL;     (* Periodic Task Real-Time Execution Scan Interval Delta-T [s] *)
    rGrade_LiquidusTemp         : REAL;     (* Steel Grade Liquidus Temperature from Metallurgical Spec [deg C] *)
    rGrade_SolidusTemp          : REAL;     (* Steel Grade Solidus Temperature from Metallurgical Spec [deg C] *)
    rBloomNominalThickness      : REAL;     (* Bloom Cold Caliber Nominal Unreduced Thickness [mm] *)
    rMSR_SegmentEntryPos        : REAL;     (* Distance along Metallurgical Axis from Meniscus to MSR Entry [m] *)
    rMSR_SegmentExitPos         : REAL;     (* Distance along Metallurgical Axis from Meniscus to MSR Exit [m] *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* --- FINAL ACTUATOR POSITION, FORCE & HYDRAULIC COMMANDS --- *)
    rCV_HydraulicGapSetpoint    : REAL;     (* High-Response Servo Valve Target Roll Gap Reference [mm] *)
    rCV_DynamicTaperSlope       : REAL;     (* Dynamic Continuous Reduction Taper Gradient [mm/m] *)
    rCV_HydraulicPressureLimit  : REAL;     (* Proportional Safety Relief Valve Pressure Cap [bar] *)
    rSeparatingForceCalc        : REAL;     (* Model-Calculated Squeeze-Flow Resistance Reaction Force [ton] *)

    (* --- METALLURGICAL CRATER END & SOLIDIFICATION STATE ESTIMATES --- *)
    rEstimatedCraterEndPos      : REAL;     (* Online Tracked Distance to Final Solidification Crater End [m] *)
    rSolidFractionCenter        : REAL;     (* Estimated Centerline Solid Fraction at MSR Segment Infeed [0.0..1.0] *)
    rSuperheatActual            : REAL;     (* Effective Liquid Steel Tundish Superheat (T_voted - T_liq) [deg C] *)

    (* --- FAULT DIAGNOSTICS, ALARM WORD & SYSTEM STATUS ENUNCIATION --- *)
    wSystemStatusWord           : WORD;     (* IEC 61131-3 Status Word (Mode, Sensor Health, Segment State) [HEX] *)
    wAlarmWord                  : WORD;     (* ISA-18.2 Process, Sensor & Metallurgical Alarm Bitfield [HEX] *)
    bSystemReady                : BOOL;     (* Segment Safety Permissives Satisfied & Operational Ready *)
    bMSR_Engaged                : BOOL;     (* Dynamic Soft Reduction Closed-Loop Squeezing Active Flag *)
    bOverloadRetractActive      : BOOL;     (* Emergency Roll Gap Retraction Engaged (High-Force Relief) *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- STATE MACHINE CONTROLLER & INTERNAL SEQUENCING --- *)
    iState                      : INT := 0; (* Primary Sequencer State Index *)
    iPrevState                  : INT := 0; (* Previous State Register for Edge Detection *)

    (* --- PROCESS CONSTANTS & METALLURGICAL CONSTITUTIVE PARAMETERS --- *)
    rK_SOLIDIFICATION_NOMINAL   : REAL := 28.5;     (* Nominal Solidification Constant K-factor [mm/min^0.5] *)
    rMAX_TAPER_RATE_CRACK_LIMIT : REAL := 1.80;     (* Max Permissible Taper to Prevent Internal Cracks [mm/m] *)
    rMIN_TAPER_RATE             : REAL := 0.20;     (* Minimum Taper to Overcome Thermal Contraction [mm/m] *)
    rFS_MSR_START_OPTIMAL       : REAL := 0.25;     (* Optimal Centerline Solid Fraction for Soft Reduction Inception *)
    rFS_MSR_FINISH_OPTIMAL      : REAL := 0.85;     (* Optimal Centerline Solid Fraction for Soft Reduction Completion *)
    rFORCE_OVERLOAD_TRIP_TON    : REAL := 280.0;    (* Critical Separating Force Mechanical Damage Threshold [ton] *)
    rFORCE_MINIMUM_SQUEEZE_TON  : REAL := 45.0;     (* Minimum Separating Force for Effective Solidification Squeeze [ton] *)
    rSPEED_MIN_CASTING_M_MIN    : REAL := 0.30;     (* Minimum Permissible Casting Speed for Auto-MSR [m/min] *)
    rSPEED_MAX_CASTING_M_MIN    : REAL := 1.50;     (* Maximum Casting Machine Mechanical Design Speed [m/min] *)
    rPRESSURE_MAX_CYLINDER_BAR  : REAL := 250.0;    (* Maximum Allowable Hydraulic Cylinder Squeeze Pressure [bar] *)

    (* --- SENSOR DISCREPANCY MAXIMUM THRESHOLDS FOR TMR FAULT ISOLATION --- *)
    rVC_DISCREPANCY_MAX         : REAL := 0.06;     (* Maximum Permissible Speed Channel Discrepancy [m/min] *)
    rTT_DISCREPANCY_MAX         : REAL := 6.5;      (* Maximum Permissible Temperature Channel Discrepancy [deg C] *)
    rPT_DISCREPANCY_MAX         : REAL := 12.0;     (* Maximum Permissible Hydraulic Pressure Discrepancy [bar] *)

    (* --- 2oo3 TMR INTERMEDIATE STATUS REGISTERS & DISCREPANCY FLAGS --- *)
    bDiscrepancyVc_AB           : BOOL;     (* Speed Sensor Discrepancy Channel A vs B *)
    bDiscrepancyVc_BC           : BOOL;     (* Speed Sensor Discrepancy Channel B vs C *)
    bDiscrepancyVc_CA           : BOOL;     (* Speed Sensor Discrepancy Channel C vs A *)
    bSpeedSensorA_Fail          : BOOL;     (* Speed Sensor Channel A Hardware Discredited *)
    bSpeedSensorB_Fail          : BOOL;     (* Speed Sensor Channel B Hardware Discredited *)
    bSpeedSensorC_Fail          : BOOL;     (* Speed Sensor Channel C Hardware Discredited *)
    iHealthySpeedSensors        : INT;      (* Count of Fully Operational Speed Transducers [0..3] *)
    rVotedCastingSpeed          : REAL;     (* 2oo3 Validated Median Strand Speed [m/min] *)

    bDiscrepancyTemp_AB         : BOOL;     (* Tundish Temp Discrepancy Channel A vs B *)
    bDiscrepancyTemp_BC         : BOOL;     (* Tundish Temp Discrepancy Channel B vs C *)
    bDiscrepancyTemp_CA         : BOOL;     (* Tundish Temp Discrepancy Channel C vs A *)
    bTempSensorA_Fail           : BOOL;     (* Tundish Temp Sensor Channel A Discredited *)
    bTempSensorB_Fail           : BOOL;     (* Tundish Temp Sensor Channel B Discredited *)
    bTempSensorC_Fail           : BOOL;     (* Tundish Temp Sensor Channel C Discredited *)
    iHealthyTempSensors         : INT;      (* Count of Fully Operational Temperature Transducers [0..3] *)
    rVotedTundishTemp           : REAL;     (* 2oo3 Validated Median Tundish Temperature [deg C] *)

    bDiscrepancyPress_AB        : BOOL;     (* Hydraulic Pressure Discrepancy Channel A vs B *)
    bDiscrepancyPress_BC        : BOOL;     (* Hydraulic Pressure Discrepancy Channel B vs C *)
    bDiscrepancyPress_CA        : BOOL;     (* Hydraulic Pressure Discrepancy Channel C vs A *)
    bPressSensorA_Fail          : BOOL;     (* Pressure Sensor Channel A Discredited *)
    bPressSensorB_Fail          : BOOL;     (* Pressure Sensor Channel B Discredited *)
    bPressSensorC_Fail          : BOOL;     (* Pressure Sensor Channel C Discredited *)
    iHealthyPressSensors        : INT;      (* Count of Fully Operational Pressure Transducers [0..3] *)
    rVotedHydraulicPress        : REAL;     (* 2oo3 Validated Median Cylinder Pressure [bar] *)

    (* --- MULTIVARIABLE STATE-SPACE METALLURGICAL OBSERVER (LUENBERGER FILTER) --- *)
    (* State Vector X:                                                               *)
    (*   X[0] = Crater End Deviation Delta_Z_solid [m]                              *)
    (*   X[1] = Centerline Solid Fraction Deviation Delta_fs [-]                    *)
    (*   X[2] = Bloom Centerline Temperature Deviation Delta_T_center [deg C]       *)
    (*   X[3] = Dynamic Roll Gap Mechanical Strain Deviation Delta_G [mm]           *)
    rState_X                    : ARRAY[0..3] OF REAL;
    rState_X_Prior              : ARRAY[0..3] OF REAL;

    (* Discrete Plant Transition Matrix A (4x4, Sampled at Ts = 0.10s) *)
    rMatrix_A                   : ARRAY[0..3, 0..3] OF REAL := [
        [0.9880, 0.0450, 0.0012, 0.0000],
        [-0.0035, 0.9720, -0.0008, -0.0025],
        [0.0150, -0.1200, 0.9650, 0.0050],
        [0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.9200]
    ];

    (* Discrete Input Coupling Matrix B (4x3: u0=GapTrim [mm], u1=TaperRate [mm/m], u2=WaterSprayTrim [l/min]) *)
    rMatrix_B                   : ARRAY[0..3, 0..2] OF REAL := [
        [-0.0120, -0.0850, -0.0045],
        [ 0.0055,  0.0180,  0.0008],
        [-0.0850, -0.2200, -0.0650],
        [ 0.0750,  0.0000,  0.0000]
    ];

    (* Output Measurement Matrix C (2x4: y0=RollGapFeedback [mm], y1=PyrometerSurfaceTemp [deg C]) *)
    rMatrix_C                   : ARRAY[0..1, 0..3] OF REAL := [
        [0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 1.0000],
        [0.1800, -22.500, 0.4500, 0.0000]
    ];

    (* Observer Gain Matrix L (4x2 Steady-State Kalman/Luenberger Matrix) *)
    rMatrix_L                   : ARRAY[0..3, 0..1] OF REAL := [
        [0.0120, 0.0240],
        [0.0045, -0.0018],
        [0.0850, 0.3500],
        [0.4200, 0.0050]
    ];

    (* --- MODEL PREDICTIVE ROLL GAP CONTROLLER (MPC) SYNTHESIS --- *)
    rU_Demand                   : ARRAY[0..2] OF REAL;  (* Raw Unconstrained Demands: 0=GapTrim, 1=Taper, 2=Water *)
    rU_Filtered                 : ARRAY[0..2] OF REAL;  (* Slew-Rate Limited Control Setpoints *)
    rU_Previous                 : ARRAY[0..2] OF REAL;  (* Storage of Preceding Task Actuator Demands *)
    rDeltaU                     : ARRAY[0..2] OF REAL;  (* Incremental Move Vector *)
    rMaxGapSlewRateMmPerSec     : REAL := 0.40;         (* Max Roll Gap Traversing Velocity [mm/s] to Prevent Cracks *)
    rMaxTaperSlewRatePerSec     : REAL := 0.05;         (* Max Taper Adjustment Rate [(mm/m)/s] *)
    rPredictedCraterEnd20s      : REAL;                 (* Dynamic Horizon Extrapolation: Crater End in 20s [m] *)
    rTargetTotalReductionMm     : REAL;                 (* Metallurgically Required Total Squeeze Draft [mm] *)
    rDynamicTaperDemand         : REAL;                 (* Synthesized Optimal Taper Rate [mm/m] *)

    (* --- THERMAL-HYDRAULIC SOLIDIFICATION CALCULATORS & METALLURGY --- *)
    rEffectiveKFactor           : REAL;     (* Solidification Coefficient Modulated by Spray Cooling & Superheat *)
    rTheoreticalSolidTimeMin    : REAL;     (* Total Shell Solidification Dwell Duration [min] *)
    rCraterEndNominal           : REAL;     (* Baseline Semi-Empirical Metallurgical Length [m] *)
    rMSR_ActiveZoneLength       : REAL;     (* Physical Length of Soft Reduction Segment [m] *)
    rShellThicknessAtEntry      : REAL;     (* Solidified Shell Thickness at MSR Entry Point [mm] *)
    rLiquidCoreCaliberAtEntry   : REAL;     (* Remaining Unsolidified Liquid/Mushy Core Thickness [mm] *)
    rHydrostaticFerrostaticBar  : REAL;     (* Molten Steel Ferrostatic Internal Pressure at MSR [bar] *)
    rRequiredHydraulicForceTon  : REAL;     (* Calculated Force to Overcome Shell Bending & Core Viscous Squeeze [ton] *)

    (* --- TIMERS, DIGITAL LOW-PASS FILTERS AND ACCUMULATORS --- *)
    tDummyBarPassTimer          : TON;      (* Tail-Out & Dummy Bar Extraction Safe Dwell Timer *)
    tOverloadSustainTimer       : TON;      (* Over-Force Duration Filter before Emergency Retraction *)
    tSteadyStateQualification   : TON;      (* Casting Speed Stability Filter for MSR Engagement *)
    rPyrometerFiltered          : REAL;     (* First-Order Low-Pass Filtered Surface Temperature [deg C] *)
    rSprayWaterFiltered         : REAL;     (* First-Order Low-Pass Filtered Secondary Water [l/min] *)
    rSeparatingForceFiltered    : REAL;     (* Low-Pass Filtered Measured Separating Force [ton] *)
    rSpeedAccelerationRate      : REAL;     (* Real-Time Time Derivative of Strand Speed [m/min^2] *)

    (* --- MATRIX ITERATION & NUMERICAL SCRATCHPAD VARIABLES --- *)
    iRow                        : INT;      (* Matrix Row Counter *)
    iCol                        : INT;      (* Matrix Column Counter *)
    rMatAcc                     : REAL;     (* Dot-Product Summation Accumulator *)
    rInnovationGap              : REAL;     (* Observer Gap Innovation Error [mm] *)
    rInnovationTemp             : REAL;     (* Observer Pyrometer Innovation Error [deg C] *)
    rMaxStepGapMm               : REAL;     (* Maximum Allowable Gap Move within Current PLC Scan [mm] *)
    rMaxStepTaper               : REAL;     (* Maximum Allowable Taper Move within Current PLC Scan [mm/m] *)
END_VAR

(*
 * ==================================================================================================
 * SECTION 0: SAFETY EMBARGO & HARDWIRED SIL-3 SAFETY INTERLOCK EVALUATION
 * ==================================================================================================
 *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    (* Hardwired SIL-3 Safety Chain Interrupted (Active-Low Emergency Interlock) *)
    rCV_HydraulicGapSetpoint   := rBloomNominalThickness + 10.0; (* Fail-Safe: Full Open Gap to Prevent Roll Binding *)
    rCV_DynamicTaperSlope      := 0.0;
    rCV_HydraulicPressureLimit := 25.0; (* De-energize Main High-Pressure Circuit *)
    rSeparatingForceCalc       := 0.0;
    bSystemReady               := FALSE;
    bMSR_Engaged               := FALSE;
    bOverloadRetractActive     := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord          := 16#E5D0; (* Emergency Shutdown State *)
    wAlarmWord                 := wAlarmWord OR 16#8000; (* Bit 15: Critical Emergency Safety Trip *)
    iState                     := 99; (* Lockout State *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Protect against zero or anomalous periodic execution interval *)
IF rCycleTimeSec <= 0.001 OR rCycleTimeSec > 2.0 THEN
    rCycleTimeSec := 0.100; (* 100ms Standard Industrial PLC Task Fallback *)
END_IF;

(* Initialize Physical MSR Segment Geography *)
IF rMSR_SegmentExitPos <= rMSR_SegmentEntryPos THEN
    rMSR_SegmentEntryPos := 18.5; (* Standard Bloom Machine Segment 5 Entry [m] *)
    rMSR_SegmentExitPos  := 23.5; (* Standard Bloom Machine Segment 6 Exit [m] *)
END_IF;
rMSR_ActiveZoneLength := rMSR_SegmentExitPos - rMSR_SegmentEntryPos;

IF rBloomNominalThickness <= 100.0 THEN
    rBloomNominalThickness := 280.0; (* Standard 280mm x 380mm Rectangular Bloom Caliber *)
END_IF;

(*
 * ==================================================================================================
 * SECTION 1: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING & INTEGRITY CHECKING
 * ==================================================================================================
 *)
(* --- SUB-SECTION 1.1: STRAND WITHDRAWAL SPEED TMR VOTING --- *)
bSpeedSensorA_Fail := (rVc_CastingSpeed_A < 0.0) OR (rVc_CastingSpeed_A > rSPEED_MAX_CASTING_M_MIN);
bSpeedSensorB_Fail := (rVc_CastingSpeed_B < 0.0) OR (rVc_CastingSpeed_B > rSPEED_MAX_CASTING_M_MIN);
bSpeedSensorC_Fail := (rVc_CastingSpeed_C < 0.0) OR (rVc_CastingSpeed_C > rSPEED_MAX_CASTING_M_MIN);

bDiscrepancyVc_AB := ABS(rVc_CastingSpeed_A - rVc_CastingSpeed_B) > rVC_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyVc_BC := ABS(rVc_CastingSpeed_B - rVc_CastingSpeed_C) > rVC_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyVc_CA := ABS(rVc_CastingSpeed_C - rVc_CastingSpeed_A) > rVC_DISCREPANCY_MAX;

IF bDiscrepancyVc_AB AND bDiscrepancyVc_CA THEN bSpeedSensorA_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyVc_AB AND bDiscrepancyVc_BC THEN bSpeedSensorB_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyVc_BC AND bDiscrepancyVc_CA THEN bSpeedSensorC_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;

iHealthySpeedSensors := 3;
IF bSpeedSensorA_Fail THEN iHealthySpeedSensors := iHealthySpeedSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bSpeedSensorB_Fail THEN iHealthySpeedSensors := iHealthySpeedSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bSpeedSensorC_Fail THEN iHealthySpeedSensors := iHealthySpeedSensors - 1; END_IF;

IF iHealthySpeedSensors = 3 THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF (rVc_CastingSpeed_A >= rVc_CastingSpeed_B AND rVc_CastingSpeed_A <= rVc_CastingSpeed_C) OR
       (rVc_CastingSpeed_A <= rVc_CastingSpeed_B AND rVc_CastingSpeed_A >= rVc_CastingSpeed_C) THEN
        rVotedCastingSpeed := rVc_CastingSpeed_A;
    ELSIF (rVc_CastingSpeed_B >= rVc_CastingSpeed_A AND rVc_CastingSpeed_B <= rVc_CastingSpeed_C) OR
          (rVc_CastingSpeed_B <= rVc_CastingSpeed_A AND rVc_CastingSpeed_B >= rVc_CastingSpeed_C) THEN
        rVotedCastingSpeed := rVc_CastingSpeed_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedCastingSpeed := rVc_CastingSpeed_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthySpeedSensors = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Dual Redundancy Mode *)
    IF NOT bSpeedSensorA_Fail AND NOT bSpeedSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedCastingSpeed := 0.5 * (rVc_CastingSpeed_A + rVc_CastingSpeed_B);
    ELSIF NOT bSpeedSensorB_Fail AND NOT bSpeedSensorC_Fail THEN
        rVotedCastingSpeed := 0.5 * (rVc_CastingSpeed_B + rVc_CastingSpeed_C);
    ELSE
        rVotedCastingSpeed := 0.5 * (rVc_CastingSpeed_A + rVc_CastingSpeed_C);
    END_IF;
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0400; (* Bit 10: 1oo2 Degraded Mode *)
ELSIF iHealthySpeedSensors = 1 THEN
    (* Critical Single Sensor Surviving (1oo1) *)
    IF NOT bSpeedSensorA_Fail THEN
        rVotedCastingSpeed := rVc_CastingSpeed_A;
    ELSIF NOT bSpeedSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedCastingSpeed := rVc_CastingSpeed_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedCastingSpeed := rVc_CastingSpeed_C;
    END_IF;
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0800; (* Bit 11: 1oo1 Degraded Mode Critical *)
ELSE
    (* Total Speed Transducer Blackout *)
    rVotedCastingSpeed := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#1000; (* Bit 12: Total Sensor Blackout Trip *)
    bOverloadRetractActive := TRUE;
    iState := 50;
END_IF;

(* --- SUB-SECTION 1.2: TUNDISH TEMPERATURE TMR VOTING --- *)
bTempSensorA_Fail := (rTT_TundishTemp_A < 1450.0) OR (rTT_TundishTemp_A > 1650.0);
bTempSensorB_Fail := (rTT_TundishTemp_B < 1450.0) OR (rTT_TundishTemp_B > 1650.0);
bTempSensorC_Fail := (rTT_TundishTemp_C < 1450.0) OR (rTT_TundishTemp_C > 1650.0);

bDiscrepancyTemp_AB := ABS(rTT_TundishTemp_A - rTT_TundishTemp_B) > rTT_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyTemp_BC := ABS(rTT_TundishTemp_B - rTT_TundishTemp_C) > rTT_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyTemp_CA := ABS(rTT_TundishTemp_C - rTT_TundishTemp_A) > rTT_DISCREPANCY_MAX;

IF bDiscrepancyTemp_AB AND bDiscrepancyTemp_CA THEN bTempSensorA_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyTemp_AB AND bDiscrepancyTemp_BC THEN bTempSensorB_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyTemp_BC AND bDiscrepancyTemp_CA THEN bTempSensorC_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;

iHealthyTempSensors := 3;
IF bTempSensorA_Fail THEN iHealthyTempSensors := iHealthyTempSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bTempSensorB_Fail THEN iHealthyTempSensors := iHealthyTempSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bTempSensorC_Fail THEN iHealthyTempSensors := iHealthyTempSensors - 1; END_IF;

IF iHealthyTempSensors = 3 THEN
    IF (rTT_TundishTemp_A >= rTT_TundishTemp_B AND rTT_TundishTemp_A <= rTT_TundishTemp_C) OR
       (rTT_TundishTemp_A <= rTT_TundishTemp_B AND rTT_TundishTemp_A >= rTT_TundishTemp_C) THEN
        rVotedTundishTemp := rTT_TundishTemp_A;
    ELSIF (rTT_TundishTemp_B >= rTT_TundishTemp_A AND rTT_TundishTemp_B <= rTT_TundishTemp_C) OR
          (rTT_TundishTemp_B <= rTT_TundishTemp_A AND rTT_TundishTemp_B >= rTT_TundishTemp_C) THEN
        rVotedTundishTemp := rTT_TundishTemp_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedTundishTemp := rTT_TundishTemp_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthyTempSensors = 2 THEN
    IF NOT bTempSensorA_Fail AND NOT bTempSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedTundishTemp := 0.5 * (rTT_TundishTemp_A + rTT_TundishTemp_B);
    ELSIF NOT bTempSensorB_Fail AND NOT bTempSensorC_Fail THEN
        rVotedTundishTemp := 0.5 * (rTT_TundishTemp_B + rTT_TundishTemp_C);
    ELSE
        rVotedTundishTemp := 0.5 * (rTT_TundishTemp_A + rTT_TundishTemp_C);
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthyTempSensors = 1 THEN
    IF NOT bTempSensorA_Fail THEN
        rVotedTundishTemp := rTT_TundishTemp_A;
    ELSIF NOT bTempSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedTundishTemp := rTT_TundishTemp_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedTundishTemp := rTT_TundishTemp_C;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Fallback Default: Liquidus + 25 deg C superheat assumed *)
    rVotedTundishTemp := rGrade_LiquidusTemp + 25.0;
END_IF;

(* Calculate Actual Superheat *)
rSuperheatActual := rVotedTundishTemp - rGrade_LiquidusTemp;

(* --- SUB-SECTION 1.3: HYDRAULIC REDUCTION CYLINDER PRESSURE TMR VOTING --- *)
bPressSensorA_Fail := (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A < 0.0) OR (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A > 320.0);
bPressSensorB_Fail := (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B < 0.0) OR (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B > 320.0);
bPressSensorC_Fail := (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C < 0.0) OR (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C > 320.0);

bDiscrepancyPress_AB := ABS(rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A - rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B) > rPT_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyPress_BC := ABS(rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B - rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C) > rPT_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyPress_CA := ABS(rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C - rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A) > rPT_DISCREPANCY_MAX;

IF bDiscrepancyPress_AB AND bDiscrepancyPress_CA THEN bPressSensorA_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyPress_AB AND bDiscrepancyPress_BC THEN bPressSensorB_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyPress_BC AND bDiscrepancyPress_CA THEN bPressSensorC_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;

iHealthyPressSensors := 3;
IF bPressSensorA_Fail THEN iHealthyPressSensors := iHealthyPressSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bPressSensorB_Fail THEN iHealthyPressSensors := iHealthyPressSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bPressSensorC_Fail THEN iHealthyPressSensors := iHealthyPressSensors - 1; END_IF;

IF iHealthyPressSensors = 3 THEN
    IF (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A >= rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B AND rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A <= rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C) OR
       (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A <= rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B AND rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A >= rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C) THEN
        rVotedHydraulicPress := rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A;
    ELSIF (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B >= rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A AND rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B <= rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C) OR
          (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B <= rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A AND rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B >= rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C) THEN
        rVotedHydraulicPress := rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedHydraulicPress := rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthyPressSensors = 2 THEN
    IF NOT bPressSensorA_Fail AND NOT bPressSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedHydraulicPress := 0.5 * (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A + rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B);
    ELSIF NOT bPressSensorB_Fail AND NOT bPressSensorC_Fail THEN
        rVotedHydraulicPress := 0.5 * (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B + rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C);
    ELSE
        rVotedHydraulicPress := 0.5 * (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A + rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C);
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthyPressSensors = 1 THEN
    IF NOT bPressSensorA_Fail THEN
        rVotedHydraulicPress := rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A;
    ELSIF NOT bPressSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedHydraulicPress := rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedHydraulicPress := rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedHydraulicPress := 0.0;
END_IF;

(*
 * ==================================================================================================
 * SECTION 2: METALLURGICAL SOLIDIFICATION DYNAMICS & CRATER END TRACKING
 * ==================================================================================================
 *)
(* Low-Pass Filter Pyrometer and Cooling Spray Signals *)
rPyrometerFiltered := (0.92 * rPyrometerFiltered) + (0.08 * rT_BloomSurfaceTemp);
rSprayWaterFiltered := (0.90 * rSprayWaterFiltered) + (0.10 * rFT_SecondaryCoolWater);
rSeparatingForceFiltered := (0.85 * rSeparatingForceFiltered) + (0.15 * rLoadCell_SeparatingForce);

(* Modulate Solidification K-factor based on specific secondary water flow and superheat *)
(* K_eff = K_nom * sqrt(1.0 + alpha*(W_spray - W_nom)/W_nom - beta*(Delta_Tsh - Tsh_nom)/Tsh_nom) *)
rEffectiveKFactor := rK_SOLIDIFICATION_NOMINAL *
    SQRT(MAX(0.50, 1.0 + (0.22 * (rSprayWaterFiltered - 350.0) / 350.0) - (0.15 * (rSuperheatActual - 25.0) / 25.0)));

(* Total Solidification Time via Modified Square-Root Solidification Law *)
(* Time in minutes to freeze half-thickness: t_solid = (D_bloom / (2 * K_eff))^2 *)
rTheoreticalSolidTimeMin := EXPT( (rBloomNominalThickness / (2.0 * MAX(rEffectiveKFactor, 10.0))), 2.0 );

(* Semi-Empirical Metallurgical Crater End Position from Meniscus *)
(* Z_solid = Vc * t_solid (m/min * min = m) *)
rCraterEndNominal := rVotedCastingSpeed * rTheoreticalSolidTimeMin;

(* Shell Thickness Growth at MSR Segment Entry Point (Distance: rMSR_SegmentEntryPos) *)
(* Dwell time to MSR entry: t_entry = rMSR_SegmentEntryPos / Vc *)
IF rVotedCastingSpeed > 0.05 THEN
    rShellThicknessAtEntry := rEffectiveKFactor * SQRT(MAX(0.01, rMSR_SegmentEntryPos / rVotedCastingSpeed));
ELSE
    rShellThicknessAtEntry := rBloomNominalThickness * 0.5;
END_IF;

(* Compute Remaining Liquid/Mushy Core Caliber at Entry *)
rLiquidCoreCaliberAtEntry := MAX(0.0, rBloomNominalThickness - (2.0 * rShellThicknessAtEntry));

(* Centerline Solid Fraction estimation via parabolic thermal resistance model *)
IF rLiquidCoreCaliberAtEntry <= 1.0 THEN
    rSolidFractionCenter := 1.0; (* Complete Core Solidification Prior to MSR *)
ELSE
    rSolidFractionCenter := LIMIT(0.0, (1.0 - EXPT(rLiquidCoreCaliberAtEntry / rBloomNominalThickness, 1.75)), 1.0);
END_IF;

(* Calculate Internal Ferrostatic Pressure at MSR entry (rho_steel ~ 7.02 g/cm3, g = 9.81 m/s2) *)
(* P_ferro = rho * g * h_vertical (approximately 0.68 bar per meter of vertical metallurgical head) *)
rHydrostaticFerrostaticBar := 0.685 * MIN(rMSR_SegmentEntryPos, 14.5);

(* Squeeze-flow model: Solidification shrinkage contraction + Darcy mushy flow resistance force *)
rRequiredHydraulicForceTon := (rHydrostaticFerrostaticBar * (rBloomNominalThickness * 0.001) * rMSR_ActiveZoneLength * 10.197) +
                              (rSolidFractionCenter * 95.0) +
                              ((rBloomNominalThickness - rLVDT_RollGap_Actual) * 18.5);
rSeparatingForceCalc := LIMIT(10.0, rRequiredHydraulicForceTon, 350.0);

(*
 * ==================================================================================================
 * SECTION 3: MULTIVARIABLE STATE-SPACE OBSERVER (LUENBERGER FILTER STEP)
 * ==================================================================================================
 *)
(* Innovation Residuals: Difference between Physical Sensor Feedback and Expected State Projection *)
rInnovationGap  := (rLVDT_RollGap_Actual - (rBloomNominalThickness - 4.5)) - (rMatrix_C[0, 3] * rState_X_Prior[3]);
rInnovationTemp := (rPyrometerFiltered - 980.0) - (rMatrix_C[1, 0] * rState_X_Prior[0] +
                                                   rMatrix_C[1, 1] * rState_X_Prior[1] +
                                                   rMatrix_C[1, 2] * rState_X_Prior[2]);

(* State Correction: X_hat(k) = X_prior(k) + L * Innovation *)
FOR iRow := 0 TO 3 DO
    rState_X[iRow] := rState_X_Prior[iRow] +
                      (rMatrix_L[iRow, 0] * rInnovationGap) +
                      (rMatrix_L[iRow, 1] * rInnovationTemp);
END_FOR;

(* Dynamic Crater End Online Estimate Combining Nominal Model + Observer Deviation *)
rEstimatedCraterEndPos := rCraterEndNominal + rState_X[0];

(* 20-Second Dynamic Horizon Projection of Crater End *)
rSpeedAccelerationRate := (rVotedCastingSpeed - rU_Previous[2]) / MAX(rCycleTimeSec, 0.001);
rPredictedCraterEnd20s := rEstimatedCraterEndPos + (rSpeedAccelerationRate * rTheoreticalSolidTimeMin * 0.33);

(*
 * ==================================================================================================
 * SECTION 4: MODEL PREDICTIVE ROLL GAP TAPER CONTROL (MPC SYNTHESIS)
 * ==================================================================================================
 *)
(* Verify if Crater End is located within the Soft Reduction Envelope [Entry, Exit] *)
IF (rEstimatedCraterEndPos >= rMSR_SegmentEntryPos) AND (rEstimatedCraterEndPos <= (rMSR_SegmentExitPos + 1.20)) THEN
    (* Crater End within optimal mechanical squeeze window *)
    (* Target Total Thickness Reduction: proportional to volumetric solidification shrinkage ~ 3.5% *)
    rTargetTotalReductionMm := LIMIT(1.5, (rBloomNominalThickness * 0.022) + (rSolidFractionCenter * 2.2), 6.5);

    (* Dynamic Taper Slope: dTaper = TotalReduction / ActiveLength *)
    rDynamicTaperDemand := LIMIT(rMIN_TAPER_RATE, (rTargetTotalReductionMm / rMSR_ActiveZoneLength), rMAX_TAPER_RATE_CRACK_LIMIT);

    (* Optimal Target Gap at Segment Exit Pinch Roll *)
    rU_Demand[0] := rBloomNominalThickness - rTargetTotalReductionMm + rState_X[3];
    rU_Demand[1] := rDynamicTaperDemand;
    rU_Demand[2] := 0.0; (* Secondary cooling trim neutral *)
ELSIF rEstimatedCraterEndPos < rMSR_SegmentEntryPos THEN
    (* Crater End has moved upstream (over-cooled or casting speed too slow) *)
    (* Strand is already fully solid prior to MSR entry - Risk of Roll Overload / Plastic Indentation *)
    rU_Demand[0] := rBloomNominalThickness - 0.5; (* Neutral Gap: zero squeeze draft *)
    rU_Demand[1] := rMIN_TAPER_RATE;
    rU_Demand[2] := -15.0; (* Trim back cooling spray to extend crater end *)
ELSE
    (* Crater End has penetrated beyond MSR Segment Exit (under-cooled or casting speed too high) *)
    (* Risk of liquid core bulging and breakout after straightener *)
    rU_Demand[0] := rBloomNominalThickness - 2.0; (* Pre-squeeze to restrict core *)
    rU_Demand[1] := rMAX_TAPER_RATE_CRACK_LIMIT;
    rU_Demand[2] := 25.0; (* Boost cooling spray to pull crater end back into segment *)
END_IF;

(*
 * ==================================================================================================
 * SECTION 5: ISA-18.2 ALARM WORD TAXONOMY & PROCESS FAULT TREES
 * ==================================================================================================
 *)
(* Preserve Retentive System Trip Flags while evaluating dynamic process bits *)
wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord AND 16#FF00;

(* Bit 0: Crater End Out-of-Bounds Downstream (Solidification Past MSR Segment Exit) *)
IF rEstimatedCraterEndPos > (rMSR_SegmentExitPos + 0.8) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0001;
END_IF;

(* Bit 1: Crater End Out-of-Bounds Upstream (Core Solid Before MSR Segment Entry) *)
IF rEstimatedCraterEndPos < (rMSR_SegmentEntryPos - 0.5) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0002;
END_IF;

(* Bit 2: TMR Speed Sensor Discrepancy Enunciation *)
IF bDiscrepancyVc_AB OR bDiscrepancyVc_BC OR bDiscrepancyVc_CA THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0004;
END_IF;

(* Bit 3: TMR Tundish Temp Sensor Discrepancy Enunciation *)
IF bDiscrepancyTemp_AB OR bDiscrepancyTemp_BC OR bDiscrepancyTemp_CA THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0008;
END_IF;

(* Bit 4: TMR Hydraulic Pressure Sensor Discrepancy Enunciation *)
IF bDiscrepancyPress_AB OR bDiscrepancyPress_BC OR bDiscrepancyPress_CA THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0010;
END_IF;

(* Bit 5: Roll Separating Force High Alarm (Overload Warning) *)
IF rSeparatingForceFiltered > (rFORCE_OVERLOAD_TRIP_TON - 25.0) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0020;
END_IF;

(* Bit 6: Roll Separating Force Low Alarm (Loss of Mechanical Squeeze Coupling) *)
IF (iState = 30) AND (rSeparatingForceFiltered < rFORCE_MINIMUM_SQUEEZE_TON) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0040;
END_IF;

(* Bit 7: Excessive Superheat Warning (Segregation Severity Multiplier) *)
IF rSuperheatActual > 45.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0080;
END_IF;

(* Bit 8: Low Superheat Warning (Risk of Submerged Entry Nozzle Clogging) *)
IF rSuperheatActual < 10.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0100;
END_IF;

(* Bit 9: Secondary Spray Cooling Flow Low *)
IF rSprayWaterFiltered < 150.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0200;
END_IF;

(* Bit 13: Internal Tensile Crack Risk (Exceeding Critical Strain Rate) *)
IF rDynamicTaperDemand >= rMAX_TAPER_RATE_CRACK_LIMIT THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#2000;
END_IF;

(* Bit 14: Mechanical Overload Trip *)
IF rSeparatingForceFiltered >= rFORCE_OVERLOAD_TRIP_TON THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#4000;
END_IF;

(*
 * ==================================================================================================
 * SECTION 6: MULTI-STAGE SEQUENTIAL CONTROL STATE MACHINE
 * ==================================================================================================
 *)
iPrevState := iState;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: INITIALIZATION & SERVO CALIBRATION *)
        bSystemReady           := FALSE;
        bMSR_Engaged           := FALSE;
        bOverloadRetractActive := FALSE;
        rCV_HydraulicGapSetpoint   := rBloomNominalThickness + 5.0;
        rCV_DynamicTaperSlope      := 0.0;
        rCV_HydraulicPressureLimit := 80.0; (* Low Pressure Calibration Mode *)

        IF bSysEnable AND (iHealthySpeedSensors >= 2) AND (iHealthyPressSensors >= 2) THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Dummy Bar Transit Tracking *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: DUMMY BAR TRANSIT (STANDBY GAP PARKED) *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bMSR_Engaged := FALSE;
        (* Keep roll gap slightly open to pass dummy bar transition head without mechanical shock *)
        rCV_HydraulicGapSetpoint   := rBloomNominalThickness + 2.0;
        rCV_DynamicTaperSlope      := 0.0;
        rCV_HydraulicPressureLimit := 120.0;

        (* Dwell timer to ensure dummy bar tail has fully cleared the MSR segment *)
        tDummyBarPassTimer(IN := (rVotedCastingSpeed >= rSPEED_MIN_CASTING_M_MIN), PT := T#90S);
        IF tDummyBarPassTimer.Q THEN
            tDummyBarPassTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20; (* Advance to Casting Acceleration & Expansion *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: CAST COMMENCEMENT & SPEED ACCELERATION *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bMSR_Engaged := FALSE;
        (* Soft clamping to touch strand without applying heavy soft reduction taper *)
        rCV_HydraulicGapSetpoint   := rBloomNominalThickness;
        rCV_DynamicTaperSlope      := 0.30;
        rCV_HydraulicPressureLimit := 160.0;

        (* Qualify speed stability and crater end entrance into MSR envelope *)
        tSteadyStateQualification(IN := (rVotedCastingSpeed >= 0.50) AND
                                        (rEstimatedCraterEndPos >= (rMSR_SegmentEntryPos - 0.5)),
                                  PT := T#45S);
        IF tSteadyStateQualification.Q THEN
            tSteadyStateQualification(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 30; (* Engage Closed-Loop Dynamic Soft Reduction *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: FULL DYNAMIC MSR ACTIVE REGIME (MPC CLOSED-LOOP) *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bMSR_Engaged := TRUE;
        bOverloadRetractActive := FALSE;

        (* Command MPC Setpoints *)
        rCV_HydraulicGapSetpoint   := rU_Demand[0];
        rCV_DynamicTaperSlope      := rU_Demand[1];
        rCV_HydraulicPressureLimit := rPRESSURE_MAX_CYLINDER_BAR;

        (* Check for Speed Transient or Flying Ladle Change *)
        IF (ABS(rSpeedAccelerationRate) > 0.08) OR (rWeight_Tundish < 8.0) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Shift to Speed Transient Compensation *)
        END_IF;

        (* Overload Detection Guard *)
        tOverloadSustainTimer(IN := (rSeparatingForceFiltered >= rFORCE_OVERLOAD_TRIP_TON), PT := T#1.5S);
        IF tOverloadSustainTimer.Q THEN
            tOverloadSustainTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 50; (* Emergency Gap Relief Retraction *)
        END_IF;

        (* Strand Termination Detection *)
        IF rVotedCastingSpeed < rSPEED_MIN_CASTING_M_MIN THEN
            iState := 60; (* Tail-Out Sequence *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: SPEED TRANSIENT & FLYING LADLE EXCHANGE ADAPTATION *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bMSR_Engaged := TRUE;
        (* During speed deceleration, crater end rapidly moves upstream.
           Dynamic taper must immediately relax to avoid squeezing solid steel *)
        IF rEstimatedCraterEndPos < rMSR_SegmentEntryPos THEN
            rCV_HydraulicGapSetpoint := rBloomNominalThickness - 0.5;
            rCV_DynamicTaperSlope    := rMIN_TAPER_RATE;
        ELSE
            rCV_HydraulicGapSetpoint := rU_Demand[0];
            rCV_DynamicTaperSlope    := LIMIT(rMIN_TAPER_RATE, rU_Demand[1] * 0.75, 1.20);
        END_IF;
        rCV_HydraulicPressureLimit := 180.0;

        (* Return to normal steady-state MSR when casting speed restabilizes *)
        IF (ABS(rSpeedAccelerationRate) < 0.02) AND (rWeight_Tundish >= 12.0) THEN
            iState := 30;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: OVERLOAD MITIGATION & SOFT REDUCTION RETRACT *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bMSR_Engaged := FALSE;
        bOverloadRetractActive := TRUE;
        (* Rapidly open gap by 6.0mm above nominal to relieve mechanical stress on roll bearings *)
        rCV_HydraulicGapSetpoint   := rBloomNominalThickness + 6.0;
        rCV_DynamicTaperSlope      := 0.0;
        rCV_HydraulicPressureLimit := 40.0; (* Dump high hydraulic pressure to tank *)

        (* Once separating force decays below safe threshold for 10 seconds, permit re-engagement *)
        IF rSeparatingForceFiltered < (rFORCE_OVERLOAD_TRIP_TON - 60.0) THEN
            bOverloadRetractActive := FALSE;
            iState := 20; (* Return to soft touch / cast acceleration *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: TAIL-OUT & CAST COMPLETION CRUSH *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bMSR_Engaged := FALSE;
        (* Final strand tail crush to close shrinkage funnel before strand clears machine *)
        rCV_HydraulicGapSetpoint   := rBloomNominalThickness - 1.0;
        rCV_DynamicTaperSlope      := 0.0;
        rCV_HydraulicPressureLimit := 140.0;

        IF rVotedCastingSpeed <= 0.02 THEN
            iState := 0; (* Cast Complete: Return to Init *)
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE 99: HARDWIRED SAFETY ESD TRIP / EMERGENCY ROLL DUMP OPEN *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bMSR_Engaged := FALSE;
        bOverloadRetractActive := TRUE;
        rCV_HydraulicGapSetpoint   := rBloomNominalThickness + 10.0;
        rCV_DynamicTaperSlope      := 0.0;
        rCV_HydraulicPressureLimit := 20.0;

        IF bEmergencyStop THEN
            iState := 0; (* Reset Lockout *)
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        (* Defensive Programming Trap for Undefined State Memory Corruption *)
        iState := 0;
END_CASE;

(*
 * ==================================================================================================
 * SECTION 7: HYDRAULIC ACTUATOR SLEW-RATE LIMITING & ANTI-CRACKING SATURATION
 * ==================================================================================================
 *)
rMaxStepGapMm := rMaxGapSlewRateMmPerSec * rCycleTimeSec;
rMaxStepTaper := rMaxTaperSlewRatePerSec * rCycleTimeSec;

(* Slew-Rate Limiter: Hydraulic Roll Gap Position Command *)
rDeltaU[0] := LIMIT(-rMaxStepGapMm, (rCV_HydraulicGapSetpoint - rU_Previous[0]), rMaxStepGapMm);
rU_Filtered[0] := LIMIT((rBloomNominalThickness - 8.0), (rU_Previous[0] + rDeltaU[0]), (rBloomNominalThickness + 12.0));
rCV_HydraulicGapSetpoint := rU_Filtered[0];
rU_Previous[0] := rU_Filtered[0];

(* Slew-Rate Limiter: Dynamic Taper Slope *)
rDeltaU[1] := LIMIT(-rMaxStepTaper, (rCV_DynamicTaperSlope - rU_Previous[1]), rMaxStepTaper);
rU_Filtered[1] := LIMIT(0.0, (rU_Previous[1] + rDeltaU[1]), rMAX_TAPER_RATE_CRACK_LIMIT);
rCV_DynamicTaperSlope := rU_Filtered[1];
rU_Previous[1] := rU_Filtered[1];

(* Slew-Rate Limiter: Speed Tracker Storage *)
rU_Previous[2] := rVotedCastingSpeed;

(*
 * ==================================================================================================
 * SECTION 8: DISCRETE-TIME OBSERVER STATE PROPAGATION & STATUS WORD PACKING
 * ==================================================================================================
 *)
(* Advance Observer State: X_prior(k+1) = A * X(k) + B * U(k) *)
FOR iRow := 0 TO 3 DO
    rMatAcc := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 0 TO 3 DO
        rMatAcc := rMatAcc + (rMatrix_A[iRow, iCol] * rState_X[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    rMatAcc := rMatAcc + (rMatrix_B[iRow, 0] * (rCV_HydraulicGapSetpoint - rBloomNominalThickness)) +
                         (rMatrix_B[iRow, 1] * rCV_DynamicTaperSlope) +
                         (rMatrix_B[iRow, 2] * (rSprayWaterFiltered - 350.0));
    rState_X_Prior[iRow] := rMatAcc;
END_FOR;

(* Compile IEC 61131-3 Status Word (High Byte: TMR Sensor Health, Low Byte: State Machine Index) *)
wSystemStatusWord := SHL(INT_TO_WORD(iHealthySpeedSensors), 12) OR
                     SHL(INT_TO_WORD(iHealthyPressSensors), 8) OR
                     INT_TO_WORD(iState);

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
